title: Models & token economy
summary: Optimize accepted outcomes, context quality, and repeated work before elaborate routing.

sections.label: Operating principle
sections.text: A lower token price can still create higher total cost if review and correction increase. Compare quality, cost, elapsed time, and review effort on the same representative tasks.

sections.label: Starting strategy
sections.text: Use code for exact work, a utility model for checkable bounded tasks, a main model for normal engineering, and stronger models when task difficulty or measured failure warrants it.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
sections.text: Compare model and deterministic options using the project task, plan a representative evaluation, and make the recommendation from accepted results and total effort. The proposed model tiers are starting options rather than measured rankings. Existing billing references were not reaudited for current account rates or access.

sections.label: Gap review: acceptance outputs
items: The comparison sheet fixes tasks, expected outcomes, configurations and acceptance rules before candidate scoring.
The result ledger reports quality, observed cost, elapsed time and human review or correction effort for the same workload.
The recommendation names the supported task class and remaining uncertainty, without claiming a measured saving from token prices alone.
